ad.headline: Free shipping on orders over $50.
ad.text: Stock up on trail gear at Alder Trail Co.

phase: Reading the ad's promises (Muse Spark Open, open weights)
Following the funnel like a customer (Muse Wonder · computer use)
Judging each promise against word-for-word evidence (Muse Wonder + quote check)

verdicts.pageQuote: Free shipping on orders of $150.00 or more
verdicts.reason: The page states free shipping only on orders of $150.00 or more, contradicting the advertised $50 threshold.

fix.summary: Lower the store's free shipping threshold from $150 to $50 to match the ad.
fix.rationale: The ad promises free shipping over $50 but the funnel states $150.00 or more, so the funnel threshold contradicts the advertised offer.
steps: Go to Store admin > Settings > Shipping and change the free shipping minimum order amount from $150.00 to $50.00.
In the same shipping settings / product page message, update 'Free shipping on orders of $150.00 or more' to 'Free shipping on orders over $50.'
Check by opening the Ridge Trail Shoe product page and adding over $50 to the cart to confirm free shipping applies at checkout.
